note: Status changes only through the commit procedure in PROMPT.md section 5, after the task's verify command exits 0. Tasks run in order.

tasks.title: write PLAN.md
acceptance: PLAN.md exists with sections: ## Architecture, ## Repo layout, ## Data model (every table with column names and types), ## Rule interface, ## Census algorithm, ## Task mapping (each task T02-T18 mapped to modules and tests).
No application code yet: src/ must not exist.
Any open decision not covered by SPEC section 2 goes to OPEN_QUESTIONS.md with the default chosen.
tasks.verify: test -s PLAN.md && for h in '## Architecture' '## Repo layout' '## Data model' '## Rule interface' '## Census algorithm' '## Task mapping'; do grep -q "^$h" PLAN.md || { echo "missing: $h"; exit 1; }; done && test ! -e src

tasks.title: repo skeleton, tooling and CI
acceptance: pyproject.toml (Python 3.12, src layout, package icp_threat_intel, console script icp-threat-intel, pytest markers integration and live registered), uv.lock, Makefile with every target in the SPEC Makefile contract, docker-compose.yml (postgres16 + pgvector + app), Dockerfile, .env.example, LICENSE (Apache-2.0), .github/workflows/ci.yml running lint, typecheck and tests.
Empty stage packages with __init__.py and core/interfaces.py defining the stage protocols from SPEC D1 (names and signatures as in PLAN.md).
A typer CLI whose --help lists every SPEC command (stubs may exit 2 with 'not implemented').
One smoke test so make test collects at least one test.
tasks.verify: make setup >/dev/null && make check && test -f .github/workflows/ci.yml && test -f docker-compose.yml && test -f .env.example && grep -q 'Apache License' LICENSE && uv run icp-threat-intel --help | grep -q census && uv run python -c 'import icp_threat_intel.core.interfaces as i; [getattr(i,n) for n in ("Collector","RawStore","Parser","Enricher","Rule","Verifier","Notifier","Exporter")]'

tasks.title: guardrails first: allowlist client, query-only IC client, redaction, disclosure gate
acceptance: Tests written first in tests/guardrails/: test_allowlist.py, test_query_only.py, test_redaction.py, test_disclosure_gate.py, test_bodies_are_data.py, test_rate_limit.py, test_no_upload.py.

Minimal implementations: shared HTTP client with ALLOWLIST and per-host rate limiting and identifying User-Agent; IC client surface exposing only query and read_state; redaction detector; publish disclosure gate; gateway body handling that never executes or follows off-domain redirects.
Redaction test samples assembled from fragments at runtime (SPEC guardrail 5).
tasks.verify: for f in test_allowlist test_query_only test_redaction test_disclosure_gate test_bodies_are_data test_rate_limit test_no_upload; do test -s tests/guardrails/$f.py || { echo "missing $f"; exit 1; }; done && uv run pytest -q tests/guardrails && make check

tasks.title: data model and initial Alembic migration
acceptance: SQLAlchemy models for every SPEC table; Postgres-only features behind a dialect check so unit tests run on SQLite.
Alembic configured; initial migration creates all tables and the pgvector extension on Postgres.
tests/unit/test_models.py covers constraints, the detection status enum and immutability of raw_snapshots and canister_snapshots.
tasks.verify: make check && uv run pytest -q tests/unit/test_models.py && ICP_THREAT_INTEL_DATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg://u:p@localhost/x uv run alembic upgrade head --sql >/dev/null

tasks.title: raw store and seed IOC loader
acceptance: raw_store saves bodies verbatim with sha256, fetch time, source and URL; idempotent on identical content; redaction applied before persistence.

data/seed_iocs.yaml contains every SPEC section 3 fact (both canisters, ThreatFox 1781006 fields, @opengov/form-renderer 0.2.20, /tmp/pglog, pgmon.service, campaign dates, source URLs) and nothing invented.
`icp-threat-intel db seed --dry-run` prints what would load without a database.
tasks.verify: make check && uv run pytest -q tests/unit/test_raw_store.py tests/unit/test_seed.py && out=$(uv run icp-threat-intel db seed --dry-run) && for s in tdtqy-oyaaa-aaaae-af2dq-cai cjn37-uyaaa-aaaac-qgnva-cai 1781006 pgmon.service; do echo "$out" | grep -q "$s" || { echo "seed missing $s"; exit 1; }; done

tasks.title: source research notes (one subagent per source)
acceptance: One note per file listed in SPEC section 5 under docs/sources/, researched from current official documentation.
First line of each note is exactly 'Status: VERIFIED' or 'Status: EXPERIMENTAL'. Each note lists endpoints, auth, rate limits, a sample response and the URLs consulted.

read-state.md records how the anonymous read_state request is encoded and which library or manual CBOR path will be used; icp-ledger-cmc.md records the top-up subaccount derivation and how it was checked.
tasks.verify: for f in dashboard-api read-state raw-gateway icp-ledger-cmc nns-governance npm pypi threatfox urlhaus github-advisories vendor-rss; do test -s docs/sources/$f.md || { echo "missing $f"; exit 1; }; head -1 docs/sources/$f.md | grep -qE '^Status: (VERIFIED|EXPERIMENTAL)$' || { echo "bad status line in $f"; exit 1; }; grep -q 'http' docs/sources/$f.md || { echo "no URLs in $f"; exit 1; }; done

tasks.title: verification state machine with two-signal constraint
acceptance: candidate -> verified only with >= 2 evidence refs from different source types; candidate -> dismissed allowed; verified is terminal except an explicit audited dismissal.
tests/guardrails/test_two_signal.py proves a single-signal detection and a two-refs-same-source detection cannot be verified.
tasks.verify: test -s tests/guardrails/test_two_signal.py && uv run pytest -q tests/guardrails/test_two_signal.py && make check

tasks.title: census package and canister inspect command
acceptance: Census walks subnets via the Dashboard API client, records canister state and diffs against the previous run (added, removed, changed fields).
`icp-threat-intel canister inspect <id> --offline` prints status, controllers, module hash, Candid methods and a raw-body summary from cassettes or the raw store.
tasks.verify: make check && uv run pytest -q tests/unit/test_census.py && out=$(uv run icp-threat-intel canister inspect tdtqy-oyaaa-aaaae-af2dq-cai --offline) && echo "$out" | grep -qi 'module' && echo "$out" | grep -qi 'controller'
